title: Kevin O NDE 8923
content: I was having an argument with my girlfriend when she stabbed me in the chest. One moment, I was sitting in a chair and the next thing I know, I was floating above my body. I was watching the paramedics attend to me but I was looking at them from above. Then everything went dark. I was was not alone. Someone was there with me and I've NEVER felt that kind of LOVE BEFORE. I did not want to leave him; I did not want to leave that LOVE. He told me that I had to go back. When I asked, 'WHY?' He replied, 'The kids are going to need you.' It was as if he knew exactly what to say that would reach my HEART and mind. Yet, to this day I have no children. But I immediately answered, 'YES! OK!' I woke up in the hospital. About 30 minutes later, that SAME VOICE said to me, 'You are about to leave again, but don't worry. You are coming right back.' Then, I flat-lined again. I was floating outside of my body again. I was watching the nurses rush into my room. I was not worried because I knew that I was coming back. I did come back and got better. Ten years later in the year 2000, I was on a bus when that same voice from my NDE said to me, 'You are about to meet your wife. She needs you and you need her.' We are still married to this day. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 1/1/1990 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Criminal attack Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function) How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes As I was floating, I watched everybody that was in the room with me. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal I don't know how high my consciousness level was. It was just very different from normal. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I don't know. Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I didn't see anything, but there was a hand on my right shoulder. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Normal Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? I felt total and complete love. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt no longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? No comment A personal relationship with GOD. Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? No comment Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I know someone is waiting for us all. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin I encountered a man with a very kind voice. Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes I felt a hand on my shoulder and heard the voice. Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes The love I felt does not exist in this life that we live here on earth. What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. I will never forget this experience. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? It proved to me that in spite of myself, GOD was waiting for me. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes When I left the hospital. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real I felt grateful for everything. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real That's hard to explain because it is something that you just know. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? Yes I was told by the same voice that I was about to meet my wife. One hour later, I met her. It's been almost 20 years later and we are still together. Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? no. Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? None. Thanks for doing this. It helps.

arrival.other_being_detail: A male presence/voice; felt a hand on his right shoulder; described as "a man with a very kind voice."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Stabbed in the chest by girlfriend during an argument.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: No comment; "A personal relationship with GOD."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Two episodes: initial OBE with darkness and loving presence/voice; later in hospital flat-lined again with another OBE and observed nurses rushing in.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE occurred, then darkness with a loving presence/voice; no tunnel, light, life review, boundary; return. A second OBE occurred after a later flat-line in the hospital.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: OBE/return repeated (flat-lined again about 30 minutes later).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Post-NDE voice communications: warned he would leave again and return; ten years later the same voice told him he was about to meet his wife, which occurred about an hour later.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I've NEVER felt that kind of LOVE BEFORE." "The kids are going to need you." "You are about to leave again, but don't worry. You are coming right back." "You are about to meet your wife. She needs you and you need her."
